scripts.title: The Last Keeper of Dreams
scripts.logline: When rioters assault a retro anime shop, a quiet shopkeeper unleashes an legendary power of resolve to protect his store.
scripts.logline_de: Als Randalierer einen Retro-Anime-Laden angreifen, entfesselt ein ruhiger Ladenbesitzer legendäre Kraft, um seinen Zufluchtsort zu schützen.

setting.color_palette: Deep amber gold, neon violet, dark navy blue, crimson energy highlights
setting.art_style: 1990s retro anime, hand-drawn cel style, visible film grain, intense shadow contrast, heavy speed-lines, dynamic impact frames

shots.camera: Low angle extreme close-up, panning fast
shots.action: Glass shatters in dramatic slow-motion; golden energy sparks fly across shattered glass panels.
shots.music: High tension synth pulse, heavy drums kick in
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, high contrast, low angle view of tempered glass shattering into glittering crystal shards, dark city street background, glowing golden sparks, hand-drawn look, heavy film grain, 16:9 ratio
shots.motion_prompt: Camera zooms violently into shattering glass, impact frames flick brightly with speed lines.

shots.action: Ren stands inside the broken store entrance, his maroon hoodie fluttering as smoke clears.

dialogue.line: This sanctuary... I won't let you destroy it!

shots.music: Driving 90s shonen action beat with distorted electric bass
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, Ren, 32yo stocky man with short spiky dark-blue hair, sharp amber eyes, thick brows, wearing a oversized dark maroon hoodie, black track pants, standing defiant inside a ruined retro anime collectibles shop with shattered glass floor, dark moody lighting, smoke haze, 16:9 ratio
shots.motion_prompt: Smoke wafts slowly around Ren while his hoodie and hair rustle in wind, fierce look on his face.

shots.camera: Dutch angle medium shot, tracking forward
shots.action: Kael charges forward out of the alleyway surrounded by angry shadows.

dialogue.line: Get out of the way, old man!

shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, Kael, 22yo lean man with wild spiky silver hair, dark face mask covering nose and mouth, wearing a dark green windbreaker jacket, sprinting aggressively towards camera, dark alley street background with neon sign reflections, dramatic shadow hatching, 16:9 ratio
shots.motion_prompt: Kael lunges towards camera with dynamic speed lines and dramatic hand-drawn motion trails.

shots.action: Kael strikes at Ren's guard from the side, causing a bright flash of impact energy.
sfx: Heavy physical impact sound with energy clap
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, impact frame, Kael, 22yo lean man with wild spiky silver hair, launching a physical blow against Ren, 32yo stocky man with short spiky dark-blue hair wearing dark maroon hoodie, golden energy shockwave burst on impact, debris flying, 16:9 ratio
shots.motion_prompt: Instant white impact flash frame, dynamic camera shake on violent hit, debris flying sideways.

shots.camera: Extreme close-up on Ren's face, dutch angle
shots.action: Ren grimaces, a tiny streak of blood on his lip, but his eyes ignite with fiery golden energy.
shots.music: Music cuts out abruptly to silence, leaving only heartbeat and rising energy hum
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, extreme close-up of Ren's face, 32yo stocky man with short spiky dark-blue hair, sharp amber eyes glowing yellow, grit teeth, small drop of blood on lip, intense dramatic shadow lines across face, glowing anime eye flare, 16:9 ratio
shots.motion_prompt: Slow push in on eyes, yellow eye-glow flares brightly with subtle camera tremor.

shots.camera: Medium wide shot, low angle, static
shots.action: Mina steps boldly into the middle, raising both hands to block Kael.

dialogue.line: Stop this right now! Leave him alone!

shots.music: Heroic emotional synth melody enters softly
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, Mina, 24yo woman with long dark brown ponytail, wearing blue denim jacket, standing bravely between attacker Kael and shopkeeper Ren, outstretched arms, glowing light aura forming around her feet, broken store background, 16:9 ratio
shots.motion_prompt: Mina steps firmly forward, hair waving in wind burst as light aura blooms beneath her boots.

shots.camera: Close-up hero shot, low angle panning up
shots.action: More neighborhood citizens step up beside Mina, forming a united front.
shots.music: Full orchestral synth crescendo, triumphant battle theme
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, Mina, 24yo ponytail woman flanked by brave city youths standing side by side, bright shimmering defensive light barrier glowing before them, fierce determined eyes, dramatic rim lighting, 16:9 ratio
shots.motion_prompt: Light barrier flares bright, citizens step up into frame synchronized.

shots.camera: Full body wide shot, tracking backwards slowly
shots.action: Ren rises to his full height, surrounded by a roaring golden power aura that pushes away all rioters.

dialogue.line: Lend me your courage... AURA SHIELD!

shots.music: Maximum volume epic 90s anime climax theme
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, Ren, 32yo stocky man in dark maroon hoodie standing in store doorway, massive golden fiery energy aura erupting around him, power lines shooting into sky, shattered glass flying outward, legendary shonen transformation pose, 16:9 ratio
shots.motion_prompt: Golden energy aura surges and pulsates vigorously around Ren, shockwave expands outward pushing back darkness.

shots.action: The shockwave harmlessly pushes Kael and the attackers back down the street.
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, wide street view, Kael and attackers shielding eyes as a golden radiant shockwave sweeps harmlessly down the littered street, smoke clearing, night street lit by golden aura, 16:9 ratio
shots.motion_prompt: Shockwave ring sweeps across street, blowing dust and debris back, rioters retreat in shock.

shots.camera: Medium shot, eye level, slow zoom in
shots.action: Ren stands calmly in his broken storefront frame, right next to a torn retro hero anime poster on the wall.
shots.voiceover: Courage is born when we protect what we love.
shots.music: Warm nostalgic 90s anime ending synth chord
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, Ren, 32yo stocky man in dark maroon hoodie standing standing calm and proud inside shattered glass shop window frame next to a large torn anime martial artist hero poster, soft warm golden twilight light, calm quiet expression, 16:9 ratio
shots.motion_prompt: Slow peaceful push in on Ren as warm light shines across his face, hair gently stirring.

shots.action: Mina offers a warm nod to Ren, who smiles subtly in return among the ruins.
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, Mina, ponytail woman looking back with warm hopeful smile towards shopkeeper Ren standing in ruined store frame, gentle evening light, heartwarming 90s anime ending scene, 16:9 ratio
shots.motion_prompt: Mina smiles warm nod, camera gently pans to reveal whole peaceful scene.

shots.action: The frame darkens slightly into an elegant end screen with text overlay.
shots.music: Final fading synth chord, gentle beat drop

source.event: Vor einem Ladenlokal in einer Einkaufsstraße liegen Scherben und Gegenstände auf dem Boden. Ein Mann verteidigt den beschädigten Eingangsbereich eines Geschäfts, wird dabei von Passanten konfrontiert und körperlich angegriffen. Umstehende greifen deeskalierend ein und rufen zum Aufhören auf, woraufhin der Mann sichtbar mitgenommen im zerstörten Schaufensterrahmen stehen bleibt.
